author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads the zone-based policy firewall's syslog from IOS XE routers and Catalyst SD-WAN edges. The devices send it to the data collector, and the parser runs as a child of the global parser Cisco_IOS_Master. Drops, passes and inspected sessions go to Netflow as blocked or allowed.
notes:
Setup:
- Send the syslog to the data collector; the README has the router and SD-WAN Manager steps (log dropped-packets, audit-trail on, drop log, pass log).

Saving in the console:
- The parser is a child of the global parser Cisco_IOS_Master, which claims these lines and leaves them without a schema.
- To add it in Sophos Fusion, choose Add Custom Parser, tick Set Global Parent in Parser Script and keep Parent parser (default): the parent picker lists only your own parsers, never built-in ones.
- Paste the whole file, !PARENT line included; its !SCHEMA line sets the schema, whatever the dialog shows.
- Without that option the save fails with "code contains restricted syntax: !PARENT"; turn the option on in the editor and save again.

Field mapping:
- Drops (%FW-6-DROP_PKT) and drop summaries (%FW-6-LOG_SUMMARY) go to Netflow as blocked; passes (%FW-6-PASS_PKT), pass summaries and inspected sessions (%FW-6-SESS_AUDIT_TRAIL_START, and %FW-6-SESS_AUDIT_TRAIL at the end) as allowed, with a summary's packet count and the bytes each side sent.
- tcp, udp and icmp become protocol numbers, and a layer 7 name such as dns goes to application_name.
- The interface, zone pair, class, reason, TCP flags and the SD-WAN VPN or VRF pair go to event_metadata.
- Lines are read with or without the %IOSXE-6-PLATFORM cpp_cp wrapper, and IPv6 addresses up to the last colon.

Time:
- The IOS XE time carries no usable zone, so it is read as UTC; keep the devices on UTC.
- A time without the year is read to the second; a line without a date keeps the ingest time.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the shapes of Cisco's IOS XE and Catalyst SD-WAN firewall syslog tables, system message guides and TechNotes; the SD-WAN summary also matches Microsoft Sentinel's Cisco SD-WAN sample data.

Testing:
- The parser passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-16, as one top-level parser and as a child of Cisco_IOS_Master (106 of 106 fields matched the emulator each way).
- Under Cisco_IOS_Master it took every firewall line in each of 27 runs, also with a line taken by its built-in child Cisco_IOS_SYS_Master before each one; no built-in child competed, and the parent added no fields.

Known gaps:
- Threshold and host alerts (%FW-4-ALERT_ON, %FW-4-HOST_TCP_ALERT_ON, %FW-2-BLOCK_HOST and others) carry no flow and aren't covered, nor are the application inspection messages of the older IOS XE message guide.
- High-speed logging (log flow-export) sends NetFlow v9, not syslog.
- The lines carry no host name.
